feature_name: Dynamic Import for Browser Extension Publisher
description: Update the extension publishing functionality to support both CommonJS and ESM versions of the publish-browser-extension package by implementing dynamic imports. This will resolve compatibility issues when users have different versions of the dependency installed.
functional_requirements: Upgrade publish-browser-extension dependency to version 4.0.4 or later in package.json
Replace static imports with dynamic imports in the publishing module to handle both CJS (< v3) and ESM (>= v4) package structures
Ensure the CLI command continues to work seamlessly regardless of which package version format is loaded
